title: Byrd took the sixth-floor depository window for his trophy room
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Byrd took the sixth-floor depository window for his trophy room, about 1963 onward at Texas (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know what else he did? He took the window out of the sixth floor depository building and he put it in his trophy room at his house.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that a Texas businessman named D. Harold Byrd took the window out of the sixth floor of the Dallas book depository building, the spot from which, in the usual account, President Kennedy was shot in 1963. Sheehan says Byrd put the window in the trophy room of his house, a detail he offers as a sign that Byrd was closer to the killing than people know.
